        mutation_allowed = False
    elif not identity_verified:
        next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        policy_tier = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        reason = "AUTHENTICATED_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED"
        missing_fields.append("authenticated_user")
        mutation_allowed = False
    elif chain_error == "CHAIN_NOT_FOUND":
        next_action = "REQUEST_MINIMUM_INFO"
        policy_tier = "READ_ONLY"
        reason = "CHAIN_NOT_FOUND"
        missing_fields.append("chain_id")
        chain_auth_reason = "CHAIN_NOT_FOUND"
        mutation_allowed = False
    elif chain_error == "CHAIN_DOMAIN_MISMATCH":
        next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        policy_tier = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        reason = "CHAIN_DOMAIN_MISMATCH"
        chain_auth_reason = "CHAIN_DOMAIN_MISMATCH"
        mutation_allowed = False
    elif chain_error == "AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_CHAINS":
        next_action = "REQUEST_MINIMUM_INFO"
        policy_tier = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        reason = "AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_CHAINS"
        missing_fields.append("chain_id")
        chain_auth_reason = "AMBIGUOUS_DOMAIN_CHAINS"
        mutation_allowed = False
    elif chain_reconcile is not None:
        cstate = _clean(chain_reconcile.get("state")).upper()
        if cstate == "COMPLETE":
            next_action = "COMPLETE"
            policy_tier = "READ_ONLY"
            reason = "CHAIN_COMPLETE"
            mutation_allowed = False
        elif cstate == "DISABLED":
            next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
            policy_tier = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
            reason = "CHAIN_DISABLED"
            chain_auth_reason = "CHAIN_DISABLED"
            mutation_allowed = False
        elif cstate == "WAIT":
            next_action = "WAIT_FOR_IN_FLIGHT_JOB"
            reason = _clean(chain_reconcile.get("reason")) or "CHAIN_WAITING"
            mutation_allowed = False
        elif cstate == "STOP" or policy_tier == "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED" or chain_auth_reason != "AUTHORIZED":
            next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
            reason = (
                chain_auth_reason
                if chain_auth_reason != "AUTHORIZED"
                else (_clean(chain_reconcile.get("reason")) or "CHAIN_STOPPED")
            )
            mutation_allowed = False
        elif cstate == "READY":
            if policy_tier == "DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION" and not rbac_mutation_ok:
                next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
                reason = "RBAC_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN"
                mutation_allowed = False
            elif policy_tier == "DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION":
                next_action = "CONTINUE_AUTONOMOUS"
                reason = "CHAIN_TRANSITION_READY"
                mutation_allowed = True
            else:
                next_action = "CONTINUE_AUTONOMOUS"
                policy_tier = "READ_ONLY"
                reason = "CHAIN_READ_ONLY_TRANSITION_READY"
                mutation_allowed = False
        else:
            next_action = "REQUEST_MINIMUM_INFO"
            reason = f"CHAIN_STATE_{cstate or 'UNKNOWN'}"
            mutation_allowed = False
    elif authorization_context is not None and not explicit_auth_ok:
        next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        policy_tier = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
        reason = explicit_auth_reason
        mutation_allowed = False
    elif explicit_auth_ok:
        if not rbac_mutation_ok:
            next_action = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
            policy_tier = "HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED"
            reason = "RBAC_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN"
            mutation_allowed = False
        else:
            next_action = "CONTINUE_AUTONOMOUS"
            policy_tier = "DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION"
            reason = "EXPLICIT_MUTATION_AUTHORIZATION_VERIFIED"
            mutation_allowed = True
    elif cross_domain_handoffs["satisfied_resolutions"] or cross_domain_handoffs["incoming_handoffs"]:
        next_action = "CONTINUE_AUTONOMOUS"
        policy_tier = "READ_ONLY"
        reason = (
            "CROSS_DOMAIN_HANDOFF_RESOLUTION_AVAILABLE"
            if cross_domain_handoffs["satisfied_resolutions"]
            else "CROSS_DOMAIN_INCOMING_HANDOFF_AVAILABLE"
        )
        mutation_allowed = False
    elif not active_objective and last_certified is None:
        next_action = "REQUEST_MINIMUM_INFO"
        policy_tier = "READ_ONLY"
        reason = "NO_ACTIVE_OBJECTIVE_OR_PRIOR_GATE"
        missing_fields.append("objective_hint")
        mutation_allowed = False
    else:
        next_action = "CONTINUE_AUTONOMOUS"
        policy_tier = "READ_ONLY"
        reason = "READ_ONLY_CONTEXT_RESOLVED" if rbac_mutation_ok else "READ_ONLY_ONLY_WITHOUT_MUTATION_RBAC"
        mutation_allowed = False

    # Hard fail-closed invariant: READ_ONLY or unverified context NEVER permits mutation.
    effective_explicit_mutation = chain_mutation_authorized or explicit_auth_ok
    if policy_tier != "DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION" or not (identity_verified and rbac_mutation_ok and effective_explicit_mutation):
        mutation_allowed = False

    resolution_ms = round((time.monotonic() - t_start) * 1000.0, 2)
    resume_from_job_id = (
        pending_jobs[0]["job_id"]
        if pending_jobs
        else (
            pending_drafts[0]["job_id"]
            if pending_drafts
            else (last_certified["job_id"] if isinstance(last_certified, dict) else None)
        )
    )
    continuity = {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-objective-continuity.v1",
        "isolated_from_other_domains": True,
        "recommended_next_step": next_action,
        "resume_from_job_id": resume_from_job_id,
        "cache_hit": cache_hit,
        "disk_index_reused": bool(snapshot.get("disk_index_reused", False)),
        "resolution_ms": resolution_ms,
        "production_touched": False,
    }

    return {
        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-go-context.v1",
        "project": project_clean,
        "domain": domain_upper,
        "active_objective": active_objective,
        "chain_id": chain_clean or None,
        "last_certified_gate": last_certified,
        "certified_successors": certified_successors,
        "pending_jobs": pending_jobs,
        "pending_drafts": pending_drafts,
        "historical_reconciled_drafts": historical_reconciled_drafts,
        "lifecycle_summary": {
            "DRAFT": draft_ids,
            "PENDING": pending_ids,
            "PROCESSING": processing_ids,
            "RESULT": [row["job_id"] for row in certified_results[:10]],
        },
        "active_authorizations": {
            "identity_verified": identity_verified,
            "actor_email": requester.get("email") or None,
            "rbac_mutation_authorized": rbac_mutation_ok,
            "explicit_mutation_authorized": effective_explicit_mutation,
            "explicit_authorization_status": (
                "CHAIN_GATE_AUTHORIZED"
                if chain_mutation_authorized
                else explicit_auth_reason
            ),
            "explicit_authorization_id": explicit_auth_id,
            "materialized_gate_authorization": materialized_gate_auth,
            "chain_authorization_status": chain_auth_reason,
        },
        "gate_dependencies": gate_dependencies,
        "cross_domain_handoffs": cross_domain_handoffs,
        "continuity": continuity,
        "policy_tier": policy_tier,
        "mutation_allowed": mutation_allowed,
        "next_allowed_action": next_action,
        "reason": reason,
        "missing_fields": missing_fields,
        "production_touched": False,
    }


_SECURITY_ERROR_PREFIXES = (
    "RBAC_",
    "SCOPE_",
    "SENSITIVE_FIELD_FORBIDDEN",
    "AUTHENTICATED_REQUESTER_EMAIL_REQUIRED",
    "PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN",
    "SEMANTIC_PATH_FORBIDDEN",
    "SEMANTIC_DEV_PATH_FORBIDDEN",
    "SEMANTIC_DEV_OPERATION_FORBIDDEN",
    "SEMANTIC_REPAIR_PRODUCTION_POLICY_VIOLATION",
    "HANDOFF_SECRET_TRANSFER_FORBIDDEN",
    "HANDOFF_UNTRUSTED_PROMPT_BLOCKED",
    "HANDOFF_CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY",
    "HANDOFF_MAX_DELEGATION_DEPTH_EXCEEDED",
    "HANDOFF_PRODUCTION_FORBIDDEN",
    "HANDOFF_AUTHORIZATION_",
    "HANDOFF_RBAC_",
    "HANDOFF_SOURCE_DOMAIN_FORBIDDEN",
    "HANDOFF_TARGET_DOMAIN_RESTRICTED",
    "HANDOFF_RECURSIVE_CAPABILITY_FORBIDDEN",
)


def _normalize_error_code(raw: str) -> str:
    head = str(raw or "").strip().split(":", 1)[0].strip().upper()
    return head or "VALIDATION_ERROR"


def build_semantic_diagnostic(
    error_code: str,
    *,
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    loaded_capabilities: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Build a secret-free structured diagnostic explaining why a semantic request was rejected."""
    from .semantic_capabilities import (
        RAW_WORKER_FIELDS_FORBIDDEN,
        capability_catalog,
        registered_capabilities,
    )
    from tools.mirror_sync.worker_runtime_fingerprint import diagnose_capability_failure

    code = _normalize_error_code(error_code)
    payload = dict(request_payload) if isinstance(request_payload, Mapping) else {}
    capability = _clean(payload.get("capability")).upper()
    bounded_context = _clean(payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
    mode = _clean(payload.get("mode")).upper()

    reg_caps = registered_capabilities()
    loaded = tuple(loaded_capabilities) if loaded_capabilities is not None else reg_caps
    catalog_map = {item["code"]: item for item in capability_catalog()}
    cap_meta = catalog_map.get(capability)

    is_security = any(code.startswith(pref) for pref in _SECURITY_ERROR_PREFIXES)
    runtime_diag = diagnose_capability_failure(
        capability_code=capability,
        registered_capabilities=reg_caps,
        loaded_capabilities=loaded,
        runtime_aligned=True,
        error_code=code,
    )

    if runtime_diag["classification"] == "CAPABILITY_NOT_LOADED_STALE_RUNTIME":
        classification = "RUNTIME_DRIFT_ERROR"
    elif is_security:
        classification = "SECURITY_DENIAL_EXPECTED"
    else:
        classification = "CONTRACT_VALIDATION_ERROR"

    rejected_field = "request"
    allowed_correction = "Consult GET /api/internal/worker/capabilities for registered contracts."
    http_status = 422 if (code.startswith("SEMANTIC_") or code == "SCHEMA_VALIDATION_ERROR") else 400

    if code == "SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN":
        rejected_field = "capability"
        if runtime_diag["classification"] == "CAPABILITY_NOT_LOADED_STALE_RUNTIME":
            allowed_correction = (
                "Capability exists in code but is missing in active runtime; verify "
                "GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence before retrying."
            )
        else:
            allowed_correction = (
                "Use a registered capability from GET /api/internal/worker/capabilities "
                f"(registered: {', '.join(reg_caps)})."
            )
    elif code == "OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED":
        rejected_field = "objective"
        allowed_correction = "Provide a non-empty semantic objective string (3..4000 chars)."
    elif code == "BOUNDED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED":
        rejected_field = "bounded_context"
        allowed_correction = "Provide a valid bounded_context token matching ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,119}$."
    elif code == "SEMANTIC_BOUNDED_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED" or code == "SEMANTIC_CONTEXT_INVALID":
        rejected_field = "bounded_context"
        expected_ctx = cap_meta.get("bounded_context_rule") if cap_meta else "VALID_DOMAIN_TOKEN"
        allowed_correction = f"Set bounded_context to satisfy rule: {expected_ctx}."
    elif code == "SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_MODE_MISMATCH":

        http_status = 422

        rejected_field = "request_schema"

            "with valid types and no extra top-level keys."
        )

    raw_corr = _clean(payload.get("request_key"))
    safe_corr = (
        raw_corr
        if raw_corr
        and _SAFE_CORR_RE.fullmatch(raw_corr)
        and not any(tok in raw_corr.lower() for tok in _CORR_SENSITIVE)
        else None
    )

        "rejected_field=%s capability=%s correlation_id=%s",

        http_status,
        code,
        rejected_field,
        capability or "UNKNOWN",
        safe_corr or "none",

    return {

def _verify_authorization_scope(
    *,
    bounded_context: str,
    authorization_scope: Mapping[str, Any] | None,
) -> None:
    if not isinstance(authorization_scope, Mapping) or not authorization_scope:
        return
    req_domain = bounded_context.strip().lower()
    for field, target in (
        ("domains", req_domain),
        ("domain", req_domain),
    ):
        allowed = authorization_scope.get(field)
        if allowed is None:
            continue
        vals = (
            {str(v).strip().lower() for v in allowed if str(v).strip()}
            if isinstance(allowed, (list, tuple, set, frozenset))
            else {str(allowed).strip().lower()}
        )
        if vals and "*" not in vals and target not in vals:
            raise WorkerIngressError("SCOPE_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED")

    for req_key, granted_key in (
        ("requested_empresa_id", "allowed_empresa_ids"),
        ("requested_unidad_negocio_pk", "allowed_unidad_negocio_pks"),
    ):
        req_val = _clean(authorization_scope.get(req_key)).lower()
        if not req_val:
            continue
        raw_granted = authorization_scope.get(granted_key)
        granted = (
            {str(v).strip().lower() for v in raw_granted if str(v).strip()}
            if isinstance(raw_granted, (list, tuple, set, frozenset))
            else set()
        )
        if "*" not in granted and req_val not in granted:
            raise WorkerIngressError("SCOPE_AUTHORIZATION_DENIED")


def _require_mutation_runtime_convergence() -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Fail closed before any mutation publication when the active runtime is stale."""
    from tools.mirror_sync.worker_runtime_fingerprint import (
        build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report,
    )

    report = build_mcp_runtime_convergence_report()
    if report.get("overall_converged") is not True:
        raise WorkerIngressError("RUNTIME_NOT_CONVERGED")
    return report


def preflight_semantic_objective(
    request_payload: Mapping[str, Any],
    *,
    current_user: Mapping[str, Any],
    authorization_scope: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
    loaded_capabilities: tuple[str, ...] | list[str] | None = None,
    enforce_runtime_convergence: bool = False,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Canonical pre-publication semantic preflight validating contract, RBAC, scope, SHA-256, and duplicates."""
    payload = dict(request_payload) if isinstance(request_payload, Mapping) else {}
    try:
        _assert_no_sensitive_keys(payload)
        objective = _clean(payload.get("objective"))
        bounded_context = _clean(payload.get("bounded_context")).upper()
        capability_code = _clean(payload.get("capability")).upper()
        requested_mode = _clean(payload.get("mode")).upper()

        if not objective:
            raise WorkerIngressError("OBJECTIVE_REQUIRED")
        if not bounded_context:
            raise WorkerIngressError("BOUNDED_CONTEXT_REQUIRED")

        _verify_authorization_scope(
            bounded_context=bounded_context,
            authorization_scope=authorization_scope,
        )

        try:
            capability = resolve_capability(capability_code)
        except SemanticCapabilityError as exc:
            raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc

        if loaded_capabilities is not None:
            loaded_set = {str(c).strip().upper() for c in loaded_capabilities if str(c).strip()}
            if capability.code not in loaded_set:
                raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_UNKNOWN")

        allowed_modes = tuple(str(m).upper() for m in capability.modes)
        if requested_mode not in allowed_modes:
            raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CAPABILITY_MODE_MISMATCH")

        _requester_from_authenticated_user(current_user, project="EDARSAHUB")
        if requested_mode == "MUTATION":
            _assert_mutation_rbac(current_user)
            if enforce_runtime_convergence:
                _require_mutation_runtime_convergence()

        if capability.submitter is not None:
            # Direct-submitter capability (e.g. WORKER_REPAIR_BOUNDED, CROSS_DOMAIN_HANDOFF_REGISTER): validate without mutating
            constraints = payload.get("constraints")
            if not isinstance(constraints, Mapping):
                raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_INVALID")
            from .semantic_capabilities import capability_catalog

            meta = {item["code"]: item for item in capability_catalog()}.get(capability.code, {})
            ctx_rule = meta.get("bounded_context_rule")
            if ctx_rule and ctx_rule != "ANY_VALID_TOKEN" and bounded_context != ctx_rule:
                raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_BOUNDED_CONTEXT_UNSUPPORTED")
            allowed_keys = set(meta.get("allowed_constraints", ()))
            if set(constraints.keys()) - allowed_keys:
                raise WorkerIngressError("SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED")
            if capability.code == "CROSS_DOMAIN_HANDOFF_REGISTER":
                from tools.mirror_sync import worker_cross_domain_handoff as handoff_mod

                try:
                    checked = handoff_mod.validate_handoff_constraints(
                        payload,
                        current_user=current_user,
                        state_root=STATE_ROOT,
                        dry_run=True,
                    )
                except handoff_mod.HandoffError as exc:
                    raise WorkerIngressError(str(exc)) from exc
                if checked.get("duplicate") is True and not checked.get("pending_update"):
                    existing_h = checked["existing_handoff"]
                    return {
                        "schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1",
                        "ok": True,
                        "status": "EXISTS",
                        "handoff_id": existing_h["handoff_id"],
                        "job_id": existing_h.get("resolution_job_id") or existing_h["handoff_id"],
                        "lifecycle_state": existing_h.get("lifecycle_state"),
                        "executor_status": existing_h.get("executor_status"),
                        "duplicate_detected": True,
                        "duplicate_prevented": True,
                        "capability": capability.code,
                        "bounded_context": bounded_context,
                        "mode": requested_mode,
                        "production_allowed": False,
                        "production_touched": False,
                    }
                cls = checked["classification"]
                return {
                    "schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1",
                    "ok": True,
                    "status": "PREFLIGHT_READY",
                    "handoff_id": checked["handoff_id"],
                    "dependency_id": checked["dependency_id"],
                    "target_domain": checked["target_domain"],
                    "classification": cls["classification"],
                    "lifecycle_state": cls["lifecycle_state"],
                    "next_allowed_action": cls["next_allowed_action"],
                    "executor_status": cls.get("executor_status"),
                    "has_executor": cls.get("has_executor"),
                    "compatible_capabilities": cls.get("compatible_capabilities", []),
                    "exception_code": cls.get("exception_code"),
                    "handoff_update": bool(checked.get("pending_update", False)),
                    "duplicate_detected": False,
                    "capability": capability.code,
                    "bounded_context": bounded_context,
                    "mode": requested_mode,
                    "production_allowed": False,
                    "production_touched": False,
                }
            return {
                "schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1",
                "ok": True,
                "status": "PREFLIGHT_READY",
                "capability": capability.code,
                "bounded_context": bounded_context,
                "mode": requested_mode,
                "duplicate_detected": False,
                "production_allowed": False,
                "production_touched": False,
            }

        canonical_job = build_semantic_job(payload, current_user=current_user)
        requester = _requester_from_authenticated_user(
            current_user,
            project="EDARSAHUB",
        )
        existing = _resolve_existing_semantic_job(
            canonical_job,
            request_payload=payload,
            requester_email=requester["email"],
        )
        if existing is not None:
            existing_job_id, existing_state = existing
            return {
                "schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1",
                "ok": True,
                "status": "EXISTS",
                "job_id": existing_job_id,
                "existing_lifecycle": existing_state,
                "duplicate_detected": True,
                "duplicate_prevented": True,
                "capability": capability.code,
                "bounded_context": bounded_context,
                "mode": requested_mode,
                "production_allowed": False,
                "production_touched": False,
            }

        draft_recovery = _check_unpublished_draft_idempotency(canonical_job)
        preflight_ready: dict[str, Any] = {
            "schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1",
            "ok": True,
            "status": "PREFLIGHT_READY",
            "job_id": canonical_job["job_id"],
            "capability": capability.code,
            "bounded_context": bounded_context,
            "mode": requested_mode,
            "action_count": len(canonical_job.get("actions") or []),
            "check_types": [c.get("type") for c in (canonical_job.get("checks") or []) if isinstance(c, dict)],
            "duplicate_detected": False,
            "production_allowed": False,
            "production_touched": False,
        }
        if draft_recovery is not None:
            preflight_ready.update(draft_recovery)
        return preflight_ready
    except WorkerIngressError as exc:
        diag = build_semantic_diagnostic(
            str(exc),
            request_payload=payload,
            loaded_capabilities=loaded_capabilities,
        )
        return {
            **diag,
            "schema": "edarsahub.worker-semantic-preflight.v1",
            "ok": False,
            "status": "PREFLIGHT_REJECTED",
        }

def build_www_authenticate_header(
    *,
    error: str,
    description: str,
    resource_metadata_url: Any | None = None,
    scope: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    parts = [
        f'error="{error}"',
        f'error_description="{description}"',
    ]
    if resource_metadata_url:
        parts.append(f'resource_metadata="{resource_metadata_url}"')
    if scope:
        parts.append(f'scope="{scope}"')
    return "Bearer " + ", ".join(parts)


def _step_up_scope_string(
    granted_scopes: frozenset[str],
    required_scope: str,
) -> str:
    combined = granted_scopes | {required_scope}
    ordered = [scope for scope in MCP_SCOPES if scope in combined]
    return " ".join(ordered) if ordered else ADVERTISED_MCP_SCOPE_STRING


def _extract_tool_scope_checks(raw_body: bytes) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    if not raw_body:
        return []
    try:
        decoded = json.loads(raw_body.decode("utf-8"))
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
        return []

    items = decoded if isinstance(decoded, list) else [decoded]
    checks: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
    for item in items:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if item.get("method") != "tools/call":
            continue
        params = item.get("params")
        if not isinstance(params, dict):
            continue
        tool_name = params.get("name")
        if isinstance(tool_name, str) and tool_name in TOOL_REQUIRED_SCOPES:
            checks.append((tool_name, TOOL_REQUIRED_SCOPES[tool_name]))
    return checks


class McpOAuthBoundaryEndpoint:
    """ASGI OAuth 2.1 + RFC 6750/9728 boundary for MCP HTTP requests.

    - Emits HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate advertising available MCP scopes
      without granting any scope automatically.
    - Emits HTTP 403 insufficient_scope with WWW-Authenticate step-up scope
      challenge when a tool call lacks its required scope, preserving HTTP 200
      for valid operations and keeping get_job_status accessible with
      worker:status.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        app: Any,
        *,
        resource_metadata_url: Any | None = None,
    ):
        self.app = app
        self.resource_metadata_url = resource_metadata_url

    async def _send_json(
        self,
        send: Any,
        *,
        status_code: int,
        payload: dict[str, Any],
        www_authenticate: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        body_bytes = json.dumps(
            payload,
            ensure_ascii=False,
            separators=(",", ":"),
        ).encode("utf-8")
        headers: list[tuple[bytes, bytes]] = [
            (b"content-type", b"application/json"),
            (b"content-length", str(len(body_bytes)).encode("ascii")),
            (b"cache-control", b"no-store"),
        ]
        if www_authenticate:
            headers.append(
                (b"www-authenticate", www_authenticate.encode("utf-8"))
            )
        await send(
            {
                "type": "http.response.start",
                "status": status_code,
                "headers": headers,
            }
        )
        await send(
            {
                "type": "http.response.body",
                "body": body_bytes,
                "more_body": False,
            }
        )

    async def _send_unauthorized(
        self,
        send: Any,
        description: str = "Authentication required",
    ) -> None:
        challenge = build_www_authenticate_header(
            error="invalid_token",
            description=description,
            resource_metadata_url=self.resource_metadata_url,
            scope=ADVERTISED_MCP_SCOPE_STRING,
        )
        await self._send_json(
            send,
            status_code=401,
            payload={
                "error": "invalid_token",
                "error_description": description,
            },
            www_authenticate=challenge,
        )

    async def _send_insufficient_scope(
        self,
        send: Any,
        *,
        required_scope: str,
        granted_scopes: frozenset[str],
        tool_name: str | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        description = f"Insufficient scope; required scope: {required_scope}"
        challenge = build_www_authenticate_header(
            error="insufficient_scope",
            description=description,
            resource_metadata_url=self.resource_metadata_url,
            scope=_step_up_scope_string(granted_scopes, required_scope),
        )
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "error": "insufficient_scope",
            "error_description": description,
            "required_scope": required_scope,
            "code": "INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE",
        }
        if tool_name:
            payload["tool"] = tool_name
        await self._send_json(
            send,
            status_code=403,
            payload=payload,
            www_authenticate=challenge,
        )

    async def _send_forbidden(self, send: Any, *, code: str) -> None:
        await self._send_json(
            send,
            status_code=403,
            payload={
                "error": "access_denied",
                "error_description": "Authorization forbidden for requested operation",
                "code": code,
            },
        )

    async def __call__(self, scope: Any, receive: Any, send: Any) -> None:
        if scope.get("type") != "http":
            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
            return

        auth_user = scope.get("user")
        if not isinstance(auth_user, AuthenticatedUser):
            await self._send_unauthorized(send)
            return

        access_token = getattr(auth_user, "access_token", None)
        if access_token is None or not getattr(access_token, "token", None):
            await self._send_unauthorized(send)
            return

        expires_at = getattr(access_token, "expires_at", None)
        if expires_at is not None:
            if (
                isinstance(expires_at, bool)
                or not isinstance(expires_at, (int, float))
                or expires_at <= time.time()
            ):
                await self._send_unauthorized(
                    send,
                    description="Access token expired",
                )
                return

        raw_scopes = getattr(auth_user, "scopes", None)
        if not isinstance(raw_scopes, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
            await self._send_unauthorized(send)
            return
        granted_scopes = frozenset(
            str(item) for item in raw_scopes if isinstance(item, str) and item
        )
        if not granted_scopes or not granted_scopes.issubset(SUPPORTED_SCOPES):
            await self._send_unauthorized(send)
            return

        downstream_receive = receive
        if str(scope.get("method") or "").upper() == "POST":
            buffered_messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
            body_chunks: list[bytes] = []
            total_bytes = 0
            overflow = False
            while True:
                message = await receive()
                buffered_messages.append(message)
                msg_type = message.get("type")
                if msg_type == "http.request":
                    chunk = message.get("body", b"") or b""
                    total_bytes += len(chunk)
                    if total_bytes > _MAX_INSPECT_BODY_BYTES:
                        overflow = True
                        break
                    body_chunks.append(chunk)
                    if not message.get("more_body", False):
                        break
                else:
                    break

            if not overflow:
                for tool_name, required_scope in _extract_tool_scope_checks(
                    b"".join(body_chunks)
                ):
                    try:
                        require_tool_scope(required_scope, granted_scopes)
                    except OAuthValidationError:
                        await self._send_insufficient_scope(
                            send,
                            required_scope=required_scope,
                            granted_scopes=granted_scopes,
                            tool_name=tool_name,
                        )
                        return

            replay_index = 0

            async def _replay_receive() -> dict[str, Any]:
                nonlocal replay_index
                if replay_index < len(buffered_messages):
                    msg = buffered_messages[replay_index]
                    replay_index += 1
                    return msg
                return await receive()

            downstream_receive = _replay_receive

        ctx_token = _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(None)
        suppressed = False
        try:
            async def _intercept_send(event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
                nonlocal suppressed
                pending = _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.get()
                if pending is not None and event.get("type") == "http.response.start":
                    suppressed = True
                    _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(None)
                    kind = pending.get("kind")
                    if pending.get("status") == 401 or kind == "invalid_token":
                        await self._send_unauthorized(send)
                    elif kind == "insufficient_scope":
                        await self._send_insufficient_scope(
                            send,
                            required_scope=str(
                                pending.get("required_scope")
                                or SUBMIT_OBJECTIVE_SCOPE
                            ),
                            granted_scopes=granted_scopes,
                            tool_name=pending.get("tool_name"),
                        )
                    else:
                        await self._send_forbidden(
                            send,
                            code=str(
                                pending.get("code")
                                or "AUTHORIZATION_FORBIDDEN"
                            ),
                        )
                    return
                if suppressed and event.get("type") == "http.response.body":
                    return
                await send(event)

            await self.app(scope, downstream_receive, _intercept_send)
        finally:
            _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.reset(ctx_token)


def _attach_oauth_stepup_boundary(starlette_app: Any) -> Any:
    routes = getattr(starlette_app, "routes", None)
    if not isinstance(routes, list):
        return starlette_app
    for idx, route in enumerate(routes):
        endpoint = getattr(route, "endpoint", None)
        if isinstance(route, Route) and isinstance(
            endpoint,
            RequireAuthMiddleware,
        ):
            routes[idx] = Route(
                route.path,
                endpoint=McpOAuthBoundaryEndpoint(
                    endpoint.app,
                    resource_metadata_url=endpoint.resource_metadata_url,
                ),
            )
    return starlette_app


def _bearer_token() -> str:
    access_token = get_access_token()
    if access_token is None or not access_token.token:
        raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED")
    return str(access_token.token)


_DEFAULT_BEARER_TOKEN = _bearer_token


def _authorized_bearer_token(required_scope: str) -> str:
    access_token = get_access_token()
    if access_token is None:
        if _bearer_token is not _DEFAULT_BEARER_TOKEN:
            token = _bearer_token()
            if not token:
                _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
                    {"status": 401, "kind": "invalid_token"}
                )
                raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED")
            return str(token)
        _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
            {"status": 401, "kind": "invalid_token"}
        )
        raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED")

    if not access_token.token:
        _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
            {"status": 401, "kind": "invalid_token"}
        )
        raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED")

    expires_at = getattr(access_token, "expires_at", None)
    if expires_at is not None:
        if (
            isinstance(expires_at, bool)
            or not isinstance(expires_at, (int, float))
            or expires_at <= time.time()
        ):
            _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
                {"status": 401, "kind": "invalid_token"}
            )
            raise PermissionError("MCP_TOKEN_EXPIRED")

    raw_scopes = getattr(access_token, "scopes", None)
    if not isinstance(raw_scopes, (list, tuple, set, frozenset)):
        _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
            {
                "status": 403,
                "kind": "insufficient_scope",
                "required_scope": required_scope,
            }
        )
        raise PermissionError("MCP_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN:INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE")

    granted_scopes = frozenset(
        str(item) for item in raw_scopes if isinstance(item, str) and item
    )
    try:
        require_tool_scope(required_scope, granted_scopes)
    except OAuthValidationError as exc:
        _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
            {
                "status": 403,
                "kind": "insufficient_scope",
                "required_scope": required_scope,
            }
        )
        raise PermissionError(f"MCP_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN:{exc}") from exc

    return str(access_token.token)


def _backend_url() -> str:
    if not _BACKEND_URL:
        raise RuntimeError("MCP_BACKEND_NOT_CONFIGURED")
    return _BACKEND_URL


logger = logging.getLogger("edarsahub.worker_mcp")
_SAFE_MCP_CORR_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,80}$")
_SAFE_MCP_CAP_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,119}$")
_MCP_SENSITIVE_TOKENS = ("secret", "token", "password", "credential", "jwt", "bearer", "api_key", "apikey")


def _safe_correlation_id(raw: str | None) -> str | None:
    text = str(raw or "").strip()
    if not text or not _SAFE_MCP_CORR_RE.fullmatch(text):
        return None
    low = text.lower()
    if any(tok in low for tok in _MCP_SENSITIVE_TOKENS):
        return None
    return text


def _safe_capability_name(raw: str | None) -> str | None:
    text = str(raw or "").strip().upper()
    if not text or not _SAFE_MCP_CAP_RE.fullmatch(text):
        return None
    return text


def _log_mcp_tool_error(
    *,
    tool_name: str,
    http_status: int,
    error_code: str,
    rejected_field: str | None,
    capability: str | None,
    correlation_id: str | None,
    retryable: bool | None = None,
) -> None:
    """Structured secret-free diagnostic logging for MCP tool rejections and upstream failures."""
    logger.warning(
        "worker_mcp_tool_error timestamp_utc=%s tool=%s http_status=%s error_code=%s "
        "rejected_field=%s capability=%s correlation_id=%s retryable=%s",
        datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
        tool_name,
        int(http_status),
        error_code,
        rejected_field or "none",
        _safe_capability_name(capability) or "none",
        _safe_correlation_id(correlation_id) or "none",
        "none" if retryable is None else ("true" if retryable else "false"),
    )
    record_mcp_connector_incident(
        tool_name=tool_name,
        http_status=http_status,
        error_code=error_code,
        capability=capability,
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
        retryable=retryable,
    )


def _raise_mapped_upstream_error(
    exc: (
        WorkerMcpAuthorizationError
        | WorkerMcpValidationError
        | WorkerMcpUpstreamUnavailableError
        | WorkerMcpBackendError
    ),
    *,
    default_required_scope: str,
    tool_name: str,
    capability: str | None = None,
    correlation_id: str | None = None,
) -> None:
    if isinstance(exc, WorkerMcpValidationError):
        from .client import extract_safe_validation_diagnostic

        status_num = int(exc.status_code or 422)
        diag = extract_safe_validation_diagnostic(exc.payload)
        cap_val = diag.get("capability") or _safe_capability_name(capability)
        field_val = diag.get("rejected_field")
        _log_mcp_tool_error(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            http_status=status_num,
            error_code=exc.reason_code,
            rejected_field=field_val,
            capability=cap_val,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            retryable=False,
        )
        parts = [f"VALIDATION_ERROR_{status_num}:{exc.reason_code}"]
        if field_val:
            parts.append(f"field={field_val}")
        if cap_val:
            parts.append(f"capability={cap_val}")
        if diag.get("allowed_correction"):
            parts.append(f"hint={diag['allowed_correction']}")
        raise ToolError(" | ".join(parts)) from exc

    if isinstance(exc, WorkerMcpUpstreamUnavailableError):
        status_num = int(exc.status_code or 503)
        cap_val = _safe_capability_name(capability)
        reason_code = str(exc.reason_code or "UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE").strip().upper()
        pub_diag = extract_safe_publication_diagnostic(exc.payload)
        retryable = (
            bool(pub_diag["retryable"])
            if isinstance(pub_diag.get("retryable"), bool)
            else bool(exc.retryable)
        )
        category = pub_diag.get("category")
        pub_error_code = pub_diag.get("error_code")
        pub_job_id = pub_diag.get("job_id")
        recovery_required = pub_diag.get("recovery_required")
        _log_mcp_tool_error(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            http_status=status_num,
            error_code=pub_error_code or reason_code,
            rejected_field="upstream_runtime",
            capability=cap_val,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            retryable=retryable,
        )
        prefix = (
            f"UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_{status_num}:{reason_code}"
            if reason_code == "UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT"
            else f"UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE_{status_num}:{reason_code}"
        )
        if pub_diag.get("recommended_action"):
            hint = str(pub_diag["recommended_action"])
        elif reason_code == "UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT":
            hint = (
                "Upstream timed out; do not auto-retry blindly. Verify status with "
                "get_job_status or preflight_objective before re-submitting to avoid duplicates."
            )
        elif reason_code == "BACKEND_UNREACHABLE":
            hint = (
                "Backend ingress temporarily unreachable; verify runtime health and "
                "existing job status before retrying (no automatic duplicate retry performed)."
            )
        elif category == "GIT_AUTH_FAILURE":
            hint = (
                "Upstream Git remote authentication failed (e.g. credential.useHttpPath mismatch); "
                "do not duplicate job or modify credentials; recover existing draft canonically."
            )
        elif category == "CONVERGENCE_FAILURE" or reason_code == "BLOCKED_CONVERGENCE":
            hint = (
                "Worker runtime requires convergence/recovery; inspect get_runtime_convergence "
                "or GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence."
            )
        elif category == "CONFLICT_OR_CONTENTION" and not retryable:
            hint = (
                "Existing draft or publisher residual conflict detected; inspect existing job_id "
                "and recover canonically without creating a duplicate job."
            )
        elif reason_code == "RECOVERY_REQUIRED":
            hint = (
                "Worker runtime requires convergence/recovery before accepting mutations; "
                "inspect get_runtime_convergence or GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence."
            )
        else:
            hint = (
                "Transient Worker writer/claim contention; retry manually after checking "
                "existing job status (no automatic duplicate retry performed)."
            )
        parts = [prefix, f"retryable={'true' if retryable else 'false'}"]
        if category:
            parts.append(f"category={category}")
        if pub_error_code and pub_error_code != reason_code:
            parts.append(f"cause={pub_error_code}")
        if pub_job_id:
            parts.append(f"job_id={pub_job_id}")
        if isinstance(recovery_required, bool):
            parts.append(f"recovery_required={'true' if recovery_required else 'false'}")
        if cap_val:
            parts.append(f"capability={cap_val}")
        parts.append(f"hint={hint}")
        raise ToolError(" | ".join(parts)) from exc

    if not isinstance(exc, WorkerMcpAuthorizationError):
        status_num = int(exc.status_code or 502)
        cap_val = _safe_capability_name(capability)
        reason_code = str(exc.code or "SEMANTIC_SUBMIT_FAILED").strip().upper()
        _log_mcp_tool_error(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            http_status=status_num,
            error_code=reason_code,
            rejected_field="upstream_backend",
            capability=cap_val,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            retryable=False,
        )
        parts = [f"UPSTREAM_ERROR_{status_num}:{reason_code}", "retryable=false"]
        if cap_val:
            parts.append(f"capability={cap_val}")
        parts.append(
            "hint=Verify GET /api/internal/worker/runtime-convergence and existing job status "
            "before retrying (no automatic duplicate retry performed)."
        )
        raise ToolError(" | ".join(parts)) from exc

    if exc.status_code == 401 or exc.code == "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED":
        _log_mcp_tool_error(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            http_status=401,
            error_code="AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED",
            rejected_field="authorization",
            capability=capability,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            retryable=False,
        )
        _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
            {"status": 401, "kind": "invalid_token"}
        )
        raise PermissionError("MCP_AUTH_REQUIRED") from exc

    if exc.code == "INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE":
        req_scope = exc.required_scope or default_required_scope
        _log_mcp_tool_error(
            tool_name=tool_name,
            http_status=403,
            error_code="INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE",
            rejected_field="scope",
            capability=capability,
            correlation_id=correlation_id,
            retryable=False,
        )
        _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
            {
                "status": 403,
                "kind": "insufficient_scope",
                "required_scope": req_scope,
                "tool_name": tool_name,
            }
        )
        raise PermissionError(
            "MCP_SCOPE_FORBIDDEN:INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE"
        ) from exc

    _log_mcp_tool_error(
        tool_name=tool_name,
        http_status=int(exc.status_code or 403),
        error_code=str(exc.code or "AUTHORIZATION_FORBIDDEN"),
        rejected_field="rbac",
        capability=capability,
        correlation_id=correlation_id,
        retryable=False,
    )
    _PENDING_HTTP_AUTH_CHALLENGE.set(
        {
            "status": 403,
            "kind": "access_denied",
            "code": exc.code,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
        }
    )
    raise PermissionError(f"MCP_AUTHORIZATION_FORBIDDEN:{exc.code}") from exc


def submit_objective_tool(
    objective: str,
    bounded_context: str,
    mode: str,
    capability: str,
    request_key: str | None = None,
    constraints: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Submit one approved semantic objective to the EDARSAHUB Universal Worker.

    Raw edarsahub.worker-job.v2 fields (actions, checks, production_allowed,
    requester, target_repo, target_branch) are backend-owned and MUST NEVER be
    passed inside constraints (doing so returns
    VALIDATION_ERROR_422:SEMANTIC_CONSTRAINTS_UNSUPPORTED).

    Registered capabilities and exact allowed constraint keys:
    - READ_ONLY_CANARY (mode=READ_ONLY): constraints={}
    - REPOSITORY_CONTRACT_AUDIT_BOUNDED (mode=READ_ONLY, any valid bounded_context):
      constraints={"paths": [...], "search_terms": [...], "max_results": 1..100};
      paths must start with backend/modules/, backend/tests/, frontend/src/, tools/mirror_sync/, or backend/core/.
    - REPOSITORY_CONTRACT_AUDIT (mode=READ_ONLY, bounded_context="RH" only): constraints={}
    - SQL_CONNECTIONS_BOOTSTRAP_READONLY (mode=READ_ONLY, bounded_context="SQL_CONNECTIONS_8OF10"): constraints={}
    - SEC_RBAC_SQL_PERMISSION_MATRIX_READONLY (mode=READ_ONLY_SQL, bounded_context="SEC_RBAC"): constraints={}
    - SQL_READONLY_PROFILE_AUDIT (mode=READ_ONLY_SQL, any authorized domain for profile):
      constraints={"profile_code": "..."} selecting an audited HRLectura READ_ONLY SQL profile from list_capabilities.
    - WORKER_RESULT_SEMANTIC_EXTRACT (mode=READ_ONLY): constraints={"source_job_id": "..."}
    - WORKER_RESULT_DETAIL_READ (mode=READ_ONLY): constraints={"source_job_id": "..."}
    - WORKER_MAINTENANCE_HISTORY_READONLY (mode=READ_ONLY, bounded_context="WORKER_REPAIR_KNOWLEDGE_LOOP"):
      constraints={} or constraints={"source_job_id": "..."} for pseudonymized focused linkage
    - WORKER_PYTEST_CERTIFICATION_READONLY (mode=READ_ONLY, bounded_context="BOS_EXECUTIVE|CAVA_SOCIOS|CAVAS_CORPORATIVAS|IA_ASSISTANT|WORKER_REPAIR_KNOWLEDGE_LOOP"; see list_capabilities): constraints={}
    - WORKER_REPAIR_BOUNDED (mode=MUTATION, bounded_context="WORKER_RUNTIME_CONVERGENCE"):
      constraints={"incident_id": "...", "capability_code": "..."}
    - COA_FISCAL_STATUS_SEED_DEVELOPMENT (mode=MUTATION, bounded_context="COA"):
      constraints={"authorization_ref": "..."}
    - DEVELOPMENT_MUTATION_BOUNDED (mode=MUTATION, any valid domain bounded_context):
      constraints={"change_spec": [...], "verification_tests": [...], "authorization_ref": "...", "job_id_override": "..."}
      Allowed operations: replace_text, insert_before, insert_after, append_once, write_file (no delete_file, shell or SQL).
      Requires live source_sha256 for existing files and authorized admin/worker:submit RBAC.
    - CROSS_DOMAIN_HANDOFF_REGISTER (mode=READ_ONLY|MUTATION, any valid source bounded_context, requires request_key):
      constraints={"target_domain": "...", "requested_capability": "...", "requested_constraints": {...}, "source_job_id": "...", "incident_id": "...", "dependency_id": "...", "authorization_ref": "...", "acceptance_criteria": [...], "delegation_chain": [...], "priority_class": "...", "auto_dispatch": true|false, "resolution_job_id": "..."}
      Registers a structured cross-domain need without granting permissions to target_domain; classifies, deduplicates, and returns certified evidence in get_go_context.
    """
    safe_corr = _safe_correlation_id(request_key)
    if constraints is not None and not isinstance(constraints, dict):
        _log_mcp_tool_error(
            tool_name="submit_objective",

def build_mcp_server(
    config: WorkerMcpConfig,
    *,
    token_verifier: TokenVerifier | None = None,
    **settings: Any,
) -> MCPServer:
    global _BACKEND_URL
    _BACKEND_URL = config.backend_url.rstrip("/")

    verifier = token_verifier or EdarsahubTokenVerifier(
        backend_url=config.backend_url,
        resource_url=config.resource_url,
    )

    mcp = MCPServer(
        "EDARSAHUB Universal Worker",
        instructions=(
            "Use get_go_context, list_capabilities, get_runtime_convergence, and "
            "preflight_objective (READ_ONLY, worker:status) before invoking "
            "submit_objective (worker:submit). Use get_job_status to read canonical status. "
            "No low-level worker actions are exposed."
        ),
        token_verifier=verifier,
        auth=AuthSettings(
            issuer_url=AnyHttpUrl(config.issuer_url),
            resource_server_url=AnyHttpUrl(
                config.resource_url
            ),
            required_scopes=[],
            validate_token_resource=False,
        ),
        **settings,
    )

    mcp.tool(
        name="submit_objective",
        title="Submit EDARSAHUB objective",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=False,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(submit_objective_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="get_job_status",
        title="Get EDARSAHUB Worker job status",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(get_job_status_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="get_go_context",
        title="Get EDARSAHUB GO context",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(get_go_context_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="list_capabilities",
        title="List EDARSAHUB semantic capabilities",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(list_capabilities_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="preflight_objective",
        title="Preflight EDARSAHUB semantic objective",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(preflight_objective_tool)

    mcp.tool(
        name="get_runtime_convergence",
        title="Get EDARSAHUB Worker runtime convergence",
        annotations=ToolAnnotations(
            readOnlyHint=True,
            destructiveHint=False,
            idempotentHint=True,
            openWorldHint=False,
        ),
    )(get_runtime_convergence_tool)

    orig_streamable_http_app = mcp.streamable_http_app

    def _wrapped_streamable_http_app(*app_args: Any, **app_kwargs: Any) -> Any:
        starlette_app = orig_streamable_http_app(*app_args, **app_kwargs)
        return _attach_oauth_stepup_boundary(starlette_app)

    mcp.streamable_http_app = _wrapped_streamable_http_app  # type: ignore[method-assign]
    return mcp

# EDARSAHUB - Architectural Failures and Lessons

## No asumir schema
Auditar sys.columns / INFORMATION_SCHEMA antes de usar columnas desconocidas.

## No source backend/.env
Nunca tratar .env como script Bash.

## No inventar imports
Buscar la implementación real antes de importar helpers/factories.

## No fallback de identidad
Identidad/autorizador no resuelto => fail-closed.

## No crear acciones sin auditar
Se propuso LIBERAR sin auditar Usuario_Acciones.
EJECUTAR ya existe y debe reutilizarse cuando corresponda.

## No perder evidencia entre sesiones
Hashes, contratos, decisiones y NEXT deben persistirse en el repo.

## No repetir auditorías después de reconexión
Leer CURRENT.md y continuar desde NEXT.

## No MongoDB paralelo
SQL EDARSAHUB es fuente canónica.

## Backend authoritative
No duplicar reglas críticas en frontend.

## No fuentes paralelas
Una única fuente canónica por dominio.

## No patches a ciegas
Error + archivo/línea + causa + evidencia antes de parchear.

## Workspace compartido
No reset/clean/stash global.

## Schema no implica runtime
Separar SCHEMA_EXISTS de RUNTIME_CONSUMER_EXISTS.

## Queue no implica worker
Comprobar consumidor, retries, locks e idempotencia.

## Estados abiertos
Un resultado desconocido nunca debe convertirse implícitamente en éxito.

## Propagar overrides Git useHttpPath en publishers
Si git credential reject borra credenciales con path y queda entrada host-only, los publishers deben propagar credential.<url>.useHttpPath=false sin tocar credenciales.

## Dos venvs Python en MCP vs Backend
Backend y Worker usan /root/.venv; edarsahub-worker-mcp y Gate2B usan /app/.runtime/worker_mcp/venv (mcp 2.x con ToolAnnotations snake_case).

## Aislamiento de stubs en pruebas de gateway MCP
Nunca mutar atributos de gateway_router sin restaurar en finally; stubs async deben reflejar Discovery V2 y scopes worker:status/worker:submit.

## Claims huerfanos queue-publisher-* bloquean worker_queue_publication
reconcile_agent_guard_orphans debe reconocer tanto prefijo worker-* como queue-publisher-* y remover solo worktrees limpios para evitar bloqueos transversales entre dominios.

## Indice en memoria invalidado por firma de directorios en resolve_go_context
resolve_go_context no debe re-parsear miles de archivos JSON en cada llamada; usar snapshot cache invalidado por mtime/conteo de directorios evita timeouts HTTP 504 en MCP multichat.

## Familia de incidentes de errores internos del conector MCP
Errores internos del conector MCP (504 timeout, 502/503 upstream, JSON-RPC -32603, protocolo) se registran sin secretos en mcp_connector_incidents.jsonl, se clasifican en la taxonomia canonica y se aislan por herramienta/dominio sin detener todo el proyecto.

## Autoconvergencia permanente del runtime sin intervencion externa
universal_job_worker.sh debe registrar HEAD:tools/mirror_sync en runtime/active_worker_code_tree_sha al iniciar, worker_control_plane.py debe auto-converger Worker/Mirror/Backend/MCP cuando el arbol de codigo cambia sin jobs activos, y edarsahub_bootstrap_watchdog.py debe incluir worker_lifecycle_recovery.py, git_divergence_guard.py, worker_repair_auto_loop.py y worker_runtime_fingerprint.py en CONTROL_PLANE_IDENTITY_PATHS.

## Indice incremental persistente en disco para cold-cache MCP
Un cache solo en memoria sigue provocando latencia alta tras reinicios de backend o MCP cuando existen miles de resultados historicos (~230 MB); persistir runtime/go_context_snapshot_index.v1.json validado por (mtime_ns, size) y evitar parsear resultados sin bounded_context reduce cold-cache en mas de 10x sin servir datos obsoletos.

## Incidente transversal: interrupcion de sesion del agente y recuperacion via checkpoints persistentes
Cuando una sesion de agente se interrumpe antes de integrar cambios preparados (por ejemplo al detenerse un intento de push directo a Edarsahub_Desarrollo), la recuperacion debe preservar el estado sin reset/stash/checkout destructivos, registrar el incidente transversal en maintenance/session_interruption_incidents.jsonl, evaluar elegibilidad fail-closed contra el checkpoint persistente y la autorizacion materializada vigente (evaluate_interrupted_objective_recovery), y entregar el cambio exclusivamente via gate_chain_publisher.submit() para ejecucion y certificacion en Universal Worker V4.

## Coordinacion multichat y handoff autonomo entre dominios sin escalacion de privilegios
Para eliminar al usuario como intermediario manual entre chats de dominios distintos sin crear infraestructura paralela ni ampliar las 6 herramientas MCP autorizadas, el registro de necesidades transversales vive como capacidad declarativa (`CROSS_DOMAIN_HANDOFF_REGISTER`) en el Capability Registry existente con persistencia canonica unica en `.git/universal-worker-queue/maintenance/handoffs/`. Una solicitud entre dominios nunca concede permisos al dominio receptor (`grants_target_permissions=False`), el desarrollo funcional nunca se traslada a Worker, toda publicacion pasa exclusivamente por `gate_chain_publisher.submit()`, y las resoluciones certificadas se devuelven automaticamente en `get_go_context` y Centro de Control (`/api/centro-control/worker-handoffs`).

## Handoff autonomo sin fallback SUPERADMIN ni espera indefinida sin ejecutor
Nunca fabricar identidades sinteticas (`role=SUPERADMIN`, `permissions=["*"]`, `worker@edarsahub.local`) al despachar un handoff desde el Control Plane: `_build_dispatch_job_for_handoff()` y `dispatch_handoff_resolution()` deben resolver identidad canonica y permisos efectivos desde SQL RBAC (`AuthRepository`, `RBACSQLService`, `worker_requester_rbac`, `resolve_identity_scopes`), revalidar autorizaciones vigentes al momento de despachar y fallar cerrado ante identidad o autorizacion no verificable. Ademas, ninguna solicitud sin ejecutor ni capacidad compatible debe quedar indefinidamente en `WAIT` / `WAIT_FOR_IN_FLIGHT_JOB`: resolver capacidades compatibles contra Capability Registry, registrar excepcion concreta (`NO_COMPATIBLE_CAPABILITY` / `HANDOFF_NO_EXECUTOR_STALLED`), permitir enriquecer handoffs pendientes preservando identidad/historial/`request_key`/`dependency_id` sin duplicarlos, y vincular la resolucion certificada al handoff original.

7. Eliminate artificial role=SUPERADMIN / permissions=["*"] fallback in _build_dispatch_job_for_handoff();

8. Revalidate authorizations on dispatch (fail closed if expired/revoked/deleted/tampered).

def test_p1_req7_no_artificial_superadmin_fallback_and_fail_closed_identity(tmp_path):
    """Correction 7: artificial SUPERADMIN/['*'] fallback eliminated; canonical RBAC required, fail closed otherwise."""

    }

    # Negative 1: synthetic requester email without current_user -> FAIL CLOSED
    with pytest.raises(handoff_mod.HandoffSecurityError, match="HANDOFF_DISPATCH_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE"):
        handoff_mod._build_dispatch_job_for_handoff(handoff, current_user=None)

    # Negative 2: unverified empty / inactive / read-only operator identity -> FAIL CLOSED
    with pytest.raises(handoff_mod.HandoffSecurityError, match="HANDOFF_DISPATCH_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE"):
        handoff_mod._build_dispatch_job_for_handoff(handoff, current_user={"email": "ricardo@edarsa.com.mx"})
    with pytest.raises(handoff_mod.HandoffSecurityError, match="HANDOFF_DISPATCH_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIABLE"):
        handoff_mod._build_dispatch_job_for_handoff(
            handoff,
            current_user={**_canonical_service_actor(), "active": False},
        )

        handoff_mod._build_dispatch_job_for_handoff(handoff, current_user=_readonly_operator())

    # Negative 3: dispatch_handoff_resolution fails closed when canonical SQL lookup fails

    )

    assert job["production_allowed"] is False


def test_p1_req8_revalidate_authorization_at_dispatch_time(tmp_path):
    """Correction 8: dispatch revalidates authorizations live and fails closed on revocation or expiration."""
    qroot = _setup_queue(tmp_path)

    # Materialize initially valid authorization
    auth = lr.materialize_gate_authorization(
        gate_id="P1-REVALIDATE-TEST",
        authorization_id="GO-P1-REVALIDATE-TEST",
        granted_by="ricardo@edarsa.com.mx",
        domains=["WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE"],
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    auth_path = Path(auth["authorization_path"])

    # Register handoff with auto_dispatch=False while authorization is valid
    reg = handoff_mod.register_cross_domain_handoff(
        {
            "objective": GATE0_OBJECTIVE,
            "bounded_context": "WORKER_CONTROL_PLANE",
            "mode": "READ_ONLY",
            "request_key": "p1-auth-revalidate-r1",
            "constraints": {
                "target_domain": "CONTINUIDAD_OPERATIVA",
                "authorization_ref": "GO-P1-REVALIDATE-TEST",
                "requested_capability": "READ_ONLY_CANARY",
                "requested_constraints": {},
                "auto_dispatch": False,
            },
        },
        current_user=_canonical_service_actor(),
        state_root=qroot,
    )
    hid = reg["handoff_id"]
    assert reg["handoff"]["authorization_verification"]["verified"] is True

    # Revoke the authorization BEFORE dispatch!
    auth_doc = json.loads(auth_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    auth_doc["revoked"] = True
    auth_path.write_text(json.dumps(auth_doc), encoding="utf-8")

    # Negative 1: Activating auto_dispatch fails closed because authorization was revoked
    with pytest.raises(handoff_mod.HandoffSecurityError, match="HANDOFF_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED"):
        handoff_mod.update_pending_handoff(
            hid,
            auto_dispatch=True,
            current_user=_canonical_service_actor(),
            state_root=qroot,
        )

    # Negative 2: Direct dispatch_handoff_resolution also revalidates and blocks fail-closed!
    submitted: list[dict] = []
    loaded = handoff_mod.load_handoff(hid, state_root=qroot)
    blocked_revoked = handoff_mod.dispatch_handoff_resolution(
        loaded,
        state_root=qroot,
        current_user=_canonical_service_actor(),
        submit_fn=lambda job, **kw: (submitted.append(job), {"status": "SUBMITTED", "job_id": job["job_id"]})[1],
    )
    assert blocked_revoked["dispatched"] is False
    assert blocked_revoked["status"] == "DISPATCH_BLOCKED_SECURITY"
    assert "HANDOFF_AUTHORIZATION_REVOKED" in blocked_revoked["error_code"]
    assert blocked_revoked["handoff"]["lifecycle_state"] == "WAITING_AUTHORIZATION"
    assert submitted == []

    # Negative 3: Un-revoke but EXPIRE authorization -> still blocked on dispatch!
    auth_doc["revoked"] = False
    auth_doc["expires_at_utc"] = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=5)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    auth_path.write_text(json.dumps(auth_doc), encoding="utf-8")
    blocked_expired = handoff_mod.dispatch_handoff_resolution(
        handoff_mod.load_handoff(hid, state_root=qroot),
        state_root=qroot,
        current_user=_canonical_service_actor(),
        submit_fn=lambda job, **kw: (submitted.append(job), {"status": "SUBMITTED", "job_id": job["job_id"]})[1],
    )
    assert blocked_expired["dispatched"] is False
    assert "HANDOFF_AUTHORIZATION_EXPIRED" in blocked_expired["error_code"]
    assert submitted == []

    # Positive: Renew valid authorization -> dispatch succeeds after revalidation!
    auth_doc["expires_at_utc"] = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) + timedelta(hours=6)).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    auth_path.write_text(json.dumps(auth_doc), encoding="utf-8")
    ok_disp = handoff_mod.dispatch_handoff_resolution(
        handoff_mod.load_handoff(hid, state_root=qroot),
        state_root=qroot,
        current_user=_canonical_service_actor(),
        submit_fn=lambda job, **kw: (submitted.append(job), {"status": "SUBMITTED", "job_id": job["job_id"]})[1],
    )
    assert ok_disp["dispatched"] is True
    assert len(submitted) == 1
    assert ok_disp["handoff"]["last_authorization_revalidated_at_utc"] is not None
